scope: Root file-only comparison of retained refusal IDs, specs and exact errors; no model execution or new numerical certificate

et_clf_maxleaf.refused: Exception: max_leaf_nodes is not ported under sklearn's semantics. sklearn's is a BEST-FIRST growth limit that changes the ORDER nodes are expanded in; cuML's max_leaves is a soft cap on a breadth-first frontier (builder.cuh:86-88) and stops pushing work once the counter is reached. They are different algorithms, so accepting the name would be accepting a different model. Use cuML's max_leaves through DecisionTreeParams if that is what you want.

gbdt_quantile_newton.refused: Exception: Newton leaves estimation method is not supported for Quantile loss function

gbdt_rmse_nan_forbidden_refused.refused: ValueError: mojolearn: nan_mode='Forbidden' but X contains NaN. CatBoost refuses this pair; this port would otherwise bin the NaNs silently with no NaN bin. Use nan_mode='Min' or 'Max', or clean the column.

pca_c8_wide.refused: Exception: gemm_tn: NUMERIC_IDENTICAL refuses the Gram shape 200 x 200 x 4096. The split-K kernel (core/gram_splitk.mojo) is the only arm with a pinned summation order, and this shape is outside its capacity (needs m == n <= 128 and m*n <= 16384 register cells). The other arm is linalg.matmul, whose k-split is a per-vendor summation order, so running it would return a NON-identical model under a mode that promises one. IDENTITY_PATHS row 27. To close this refusal, widen the split-K kernel's staging tile; to work around it today, reduce the feature count or run NUMERIC_FAST and drop the cross-vendor claim.

pca_c8_wide.refused: Exception: gemm_tn: NUMERIC_IDENTICAL refuses the Gram shape 200 x 200 x 4096. The split-K kernel (core/gram_splitk.mojo) is the only arm with a pinned summation order, and this shape is outside its capacity (needs m == n <= 128 and m*n <= 16384 register cells). The other arm is linalg.matmul, whose k-split is a per-vendor summation order, so running it would return a NON-identical model under a mode that promises one. IDENTITY_PATHS row 27. To close this refusal, widen the split-K kernel's staging tile; to work around it today, reduce the feature count or run NUMERIC_FAST and drop the cross-vendor claim.
